description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to the market Number 46 Duirling, a spacious four-bedroom duplex townhouse situated in the heart of Roscam.

This cleverly designed home occupies an exceptionally convenient location overlooking beautifully maintained communal green spaces, with ample parking and an extensive range of amenities close at hand. Offering generous accommodation throughout, Number 46 represents outstanding value for money in one of Galway’s most sought-after residential areas.

On arrival, the mature communal gardens create a wonderful sense of space, nature and privacy to the front of the property. Internally, a bright entrance hallway, finished with contemporary wood flooring, leads into a spacious kitchen and dining area featuring ample built-in units and delightful views across the gardens.

To the rear lies the exceptionally generous living room, complete with contemporary wood flooring, a marble fireplace and an abundance of floor space. A large window and glazed patio doors flood the room with natural light, while the doors open onto a private balcony overlooking the gardens below. A convenient guest WC completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, a spacious landing provides access to four well-proportioned bedrooms. These comprise a generous principal bedroom with en-suite, a second double bedroom overlooking the front of the property, a large rear bedroom currently used as a home office, and a further single bedroom to the front.

If you are searching for a modern, spacious and beautifully positioned family home in the heart of Roscam, just moments from Galway City and surrounded by excellent amenities, we suggest that you look no further than Number 46 Duirling. 

With its outstanding communal gardens, ample parking and superbly proportioned accommodation, this exceptional property is certain to exceed your expectations.
